gaps.why: Greece has several hundred thousand tiny farms; OPEKEPE was absorbed into AADE in 2026 after the scandal, new e-declaration rules and stricter parcel checks (LPIS, satellite monitoring) are live this autumn. Only pesticide, bee, vet and co-op angles were covered, not the farmer's own mandatory annual declaration, which is mostly done by KYDEP/accountants.

gaps.why: Category 13 was never searched. Drinking-water directive transposition (KYA 2023 for Directive 2020/2184) imposes monitoring and risk-assessment duties on small suppliers, hotels, camps, tourist pools and DEYA-adjacent operators; many small tourist units are affected.

gaps.category: Cemetery, burial societies and ecclesiastical/parish bodies (not_reached) and church-related associations

gaps.why: Greece has a huge long tail of small hotels, rooms-to-let, cafes, tourist shops and travel agencies; AMA/STR (rejected) and climate fee are covered but the operating sign renewal, yearly classification, tourist-enterprise register (Μητρώο Τουριστικών Επιχειρήσεων) and Law 5162/2024 / new rules for tourist accommodations (inspections, fines, capacity) were not.

gaps.category: Municipal licences for retail and catering premises (κατάλογος καταστημάτων υγειονομικού ενδιαφέροντος): café-bars, kiosks (περίπτερα), outdoor tables (τραπεζοκαθίσματα) and municipal fees
gaps.first_search: άδεια ΥΥΕ υγειονομικού ενδιαφέροντος 2026 ηλεκτρονική υποβολή τραπεζοκαθίσματα δήμος παράβολο ανανέωση γνωστοποίηση νέα ΚΥΑ
gaps.why: Greece has a very high density of cafes, tavernas and kiosks; municipal annual duties (άδεια λειτουργίας, χρήση κοινόχρηστου χώρου via the ΟΠΣ-ΚΕΠ/e-adeies platform, fire-safety, noise, ΤΑΠ and municipal fee returns) fall on tiny operators. Only fish tavernas and generic food-training were touched.

gaps.category: Environmental and recycling producer-responsibility duties on small operators: packaging (ΕΟΑΝ/ΑΝΑΚΥΚΛΩΣΗ), used cooking oil, batteries, WEEE, tyres and the new EPR/plastic rules; ΗΜΑ producer registry
gaps.first_search: σύστημα επιστροφής και επαναπλήρωσης συσκευασιών ποτών 2026 εγγραφή ΗΜΑ μικρές επιχειρήσεις υποχρεώσεις Ν. 5037/2023 ΕΟΑΝ
gaps.why: Thin: only waste haulers and scrap dealers were searched. Small retailers, restaurants, garages and importers have mandatory registrations and reporting to the producer-responsibility bodies (Law 4819/2021, Law 5037/2023 deposit-return on beverage containers from 2026), plus used cooking oil and tyres; a deposit-return rollout is a deadline that makes many small shops act at once.

coverage.found: One search; nothing specific to household employers. Only general e-EFKA employer register (needs a sole-trader start), APD pre-fill from ERGANI II (ΦΕΚ Β' 465/10.02.2025) for registered employers, and the worker-side complaint tool. No new rule or deadline found. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: Two searches. No scrap-specific licence or register found. Dealers fall under the HMA waste register (L.4819/2021); the EU Digital Waste Shipment System rules apply from 21 May 2026 (cross-border only). RAAEY waste tracking platform is aimed at municipal waste. Weak unverified candidate logged.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: New mandatory AADE register of used-vehicle dealers (law 5259/2025 art.180, Art.52 VAT Code paras 12A-12D, 13A; start date set by AADE Governor decision, not found). Police regulation ΑΠΟΦ 1010/10/5 (ΦΕΚ Β' 1948/2011) covers pawnbrokers and second-hand dealers (start notification to the Security Dept). Imported-used-vehicle register ΜΕΜΟ for trailers O1-O3 starts 16-07-2026 (unverified).

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: Same police regulation as category 3 (also covers melting and trade in used gold jewellery). AML duties under L.4557/2018 are from memory only and unverified. No digital register or deadline found.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: One search. Only EDOE (the end-of-life vehicle scheme) and authorised ΟΤΚΖ centres. No new register or deadline found for dismantlers or used-parts sellers. The used-vehicle dealer register (category 3) may touch some dismantlers.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: Animal-transporter licences Type I and II (5 years, DAOK) and vehicle approval, per mitos.gov.gr; transporter training 2-4 Feb 2026. Sheep/goat bolus rollout is known (K08). No livestock-trader register found. Nothing new beyond K04/K08.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: Abattoir capacity criteria ΥΑ 360/116675/2024 (ΦΕΚ 2662/Β/2-5-2024). EFET mandatory food-business staff training, circular approved by decision 84/20-02-2026, with ΥΑ 110581/2025 and circular 7151/2026. Candidate logged (weak, cross-sector).

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: National Electronic Beekeeping Register is mandatory from 5 hives. Annual hive declaration runs 1 Sep-20 Oct (deadline 11 days away today). Changes are declared within 15 days. CAP bee measure pays +50% for hives moved with GPS and date records. 2026 sanctions announcement. Candidate logged.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: Vet e-prescription (ΥΑ 407523/2024, ΦΕΚ Β' 7607/31.12.2024): cattle, pigs, poultry from 1 Jan 2025; sheep/goats, fish, rabbits, horses from 1 Jan 2026. L.5302/2026 makes bolus fitting and traceability entries vet-only. Nothing new beyond K04 and K08.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: One search. The 2014 KYA (ΦΕΚ 2878/Β/27-10-2014) sets water-use licences, the EMSY register of abstraction points and a mandatory water meter. Nothing found on a 2026 deadline. Unverified weak candidate logged.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: Waste collection and transport firms register in the HMA instead of holding a licence (L.4042/2012 art.42, KYA 43942/4026/2016) and need EUR 100,000 liability insurance since Oct 2020. Not confirmed whether septic haulers fall under it; no 2026 change found.

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: Strong lead. National elevator census on elevator.mindev.gov.gr: about 286,000 of about 310,000 elevators declared; deadline extended from 30 Nov 2025 to 30 Jun 2026, with no further extension allowed. Fines per elevator EUR 1,000 (residential), 2,500 (commercial) or 5,000 (public-access); sealing reported. Next phase is a permanent registry with phased certification and registration by construction decade. Boilers and pressure equipment: nothing found.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: No search spent; budget used on categories with live signals.

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: Professional users need a usage prescription (art.45) and an application diary; retailers must log sales on the special sale form electronically; inspected under 2024 guidance 2119/52356/21.02.2024. No new 2026 digital diary rule found. Weak candidate logged.

coverage.found: Private job agencies (IGEE) and temp-work agencies (EPA) file activity reports through ERGANI under ΥΑ 45675/1393 (ΦΕΚ 5039/Β/13-11-2020). The 1-15 Jan and 1-15 Jul windows were extended to 31.01.2026 and 31.07.2026. Weak candidate logged.

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: No targeted search. Funeral homes are known (K07). The only related hit was L.4735/2020 on cemetery chapels, which is not a software duty.

coverage.found: One search. Only L.4735/2020 on cemetery chapels, the GEMI e-filing deadline (ΥΑ 36588) and the civil-protection volunteer register. Halal and kosher supervision not searched. Nothing new.

A bill adds a digital passenger-rating platform with QR codes. Taxi EV rules are unclear. Full texts not read. Unverified candidate logged.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Money changers: only an old Bank of Greece framework (L.2515/1997 art.15, Governor's Act 2541/2004). No 2026 rule and no street-vendor material found. Nothing new beyond K06.

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Tattoo and piercing: new health provision Δ1γ/Γ.Π/οικ.54327 (ΦΕΚ Β' 6633/10.12.2025). Driving schools: only old rules, nothing new. Private nurseries: the ESPA/EETAA voucher platform is parent-facing; no operator duty found. Hunting: season and fee FEKs only (ΦΕΚ Β' 4804 and 4873/2026); nothing for outfitters. Small food producers: only the EFET training circular.

coverage.category: 21. Fuel stations and fuel or LPG distributors
coverage.found: Live 2026 rule set: AADE tank registry (KYA A.1180/2025, A.1200/2026) and input-output (εισροές-εκροές) system upgrade (A.1176/2024, A.1202/2026). AADE press release of 2 Oct 2026 postponed deadlines: public stations 30/06/2027 (Attica, Thessaloniki) and 31/12/2027 (rest); private-use stations 31/12/2027; tank census 31/12/2027. Duty also covers heating-oil sellers, installers, software makers and accredited tank-volumetry bodies. Voucher up to 3,000 EUR for equipment upgrade (March 2026 release). Fines up to 15,000 EUR for tank-registry non-registration (Oct 2025 source). Candidates C1, C2.

coverage.category: 22. Grain, coffee, cocoa and other commodity traders, millers and warehouses
coverage.found: Only the 2022 emergency agricultural-stock declaration (Law 4916/2022 art. 87, KYA 1368/2022, extended 2023); no 2026 rule found, status of the duty today unverified. EUDR touches coffee and cocoa importers (see C5). Nothing new beyond K15/K16 for mills and dairies.

coverage.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
coverage.found: Agricultural co-ops and producer groups register in the National Registry of Agricultural Cooperatives (Law 4673/2020 art. 22) and must upload articles, elections and annual accounts to get a compliance certificate; articles update deadline lapsed 30/06/2024. KoinSEp (Law 4430/2016) file an annual activity plan and financial report with the Social Economy Registry. No 2026 change found. Candidates C9, C10 (weak). No credit-union equivalent found.

coverage.category: 24. Private clinics, labs and other health providers that bill insurers or state schemes
coverage.found: EOPYY: clawback/rebate rules for diagnostic labs (Ministerial decision EALE/G.P.41234/19.9.2025); ICU beds in private clinics must be declared in the EKAB system for 2026 (EOPYY notice 10/02/2026); physiotherapist e-DAPY now requires patient OTP since 3 Feb 2025; monthly claim submission via eDAPY with extensions (Jan 2026 claims to 10/03/2026). All run through EOPYY/IDIKA portals, no named third-party gap found. Candidates C8 (weak). Nothing new beyond K04 for vets.

coverage.category: 25. Pharmacies, medicine importers, and users of controlled chemicals or precursors
coverage.found: Electronic narcotics book already automated (Law 4812/2021 art. 78, retroactive from 1/7/2021); PFS temporary new-EOPYY-contract procedure (2026); no 2026 KYA changing pharmacy duties found. Nothing new. Precursor/controlled-chemical users not reached (no search).

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: Digital Work Card now statutory (Labour Code P.D. 62/2025 art. 580, full application from 3.11.2025); sector KAD lists updated by decisions 15441/28-05-2026 and 18047/24-06-2026 (FEK B 3791/29-06-2026). Already rejected as K10/K13 (free Epsilon Smart Ergani). No security- or cleaning-specific duty found. Nothing new beyond K10.

coverage.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers: site registers, accreditation, local-content reports
coverage.found: Digital certificate for contractor/subcontractor technical-works agreements above 6,000 EUR via free gov.gr/AADE app (A.1152/2024, KYA 1668/2025, in force from 1/11/2024, fine-free window ended 28/02/2025). Free state tool; candidate C6 (weak). No digital site book or ΜΕΕΠ/EFKA 2026 rule found in results. Mining/quarry not reached.

coverage.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
coverage.found: AML duties under Law 4557/2018 (brokers, accountants and others: customer identification, monitoring, fines up to 1M EUR); Beneficial Owners Register art. 20 (entry within 60 days of change, 10,000 EUR fine, tax-certificate block). No 2026 Greek change found (results were Australia/UK/Slovakia). Candidate C7 (weak, unverified). Nothing else new.

coverage.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
coverage.found: Climate Resilience Fee (Τέλος Ανθεκτικότητας), monthly return via myAADE by end of following month, March-October, amounts 0.50-15 EUR; replaces the old accommodation levy. Police guest register duty not confirmed. STR already rejected (K11). Candidate C11 (weak).

coverage.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
coverage.found: EUDR (Reg. 2023/1115, amended by Reg. 2025/2650): application 30 Dec 2026 for medium and large firms and small timber firms, 30 Jun 2027 for other micro and small firms; Commission simplification package 4 May 2026. Greek authority and national register not identified. Fish already K05. Candidate C5.

coverage.category: 31. Contractor/subcontractor agreement digital certification (country-specific)
coverage.found: See C6. Free state app, per-contract filing.

coverage.category: 32. Professional pleasure-craft charter: e-Ναυλοσύμφωνο, vessel registry, stay fee (country-specific)
coverage.found: Register of tourist vessels and small craft is a TAXIS subsystem (Law 4256/2014), mandatory for professional pleasure craft; electronic charter-party and crew/passenger lists submitted online; link to the Tέλος Παραμονής Πλόων; minimum operating days rule. Booking Manager already exports the Greek crew-list format. Candidate C3.

coverage.category: 33. Beach and seashore concession holders (country-specific, Law 5092/2024)
coverage.found: Jan 2026 KYA 11996 EX/2026 (FEK B 283), amended by 43966 EX/2026 (FEK B 1490/16-03-2026): online platform for adjacent-business concession requests; e-auctions on eauctions.gsis.gr for 1,200+ concessions; 6,500 live concessions in the digital registry; QR sign with coordinates and concession number, 500 sq m cap, 50 percent free beach, lifeguard and sanitary duties, joint inspections and fines. Candidate C4.

coverage.category: 34. Vehicle rental firms: Digital Vehicle Client Registry (country-specific)
coverage.found: A.1057/2025: rental of cars, motorbikes and mopeds covered, mandatory from 1 July 2025. Same duty as K03/K14 (commoditised by ERP and booking SaaS). Listed as C12 known.

coverage.category: 35. Apartment-building (πολυκατοικία) managers (country-specific)
coverage.found: Special KAD 68.32.11.04 for managers; building AFM; myΘέρμανση heating-allowance data (shares, residents, invoices) each autumn; May 2026 bill proposal to separate common-expense flows from manager revenue (not confirmed enacted). Candidate C13 (weak).

coverage.category: 36. Occupational safety technician and doctor appointments (country-specific)
coverage.found: Labour Code P.D. 62/2025 art. 499; every employer with at least one worker needs a safety technician registered in OPS SEPE; occupational doctor from 50 workers (or hazard types). Annual report via ERGANI II not confirmed. Generic and done by external service providers; no candidate scored 3+.

coverage.category: 37. Social economy enterprises (KoinSEp) annual duties (country-specific)
coverage.found: Mandatory registry and annual activity programme plus financial report under Law 4430/2016; tiny population. Candidate C10 (weak).
